description.en: A minimal personal website built with Astro and Tailwind CSS, featuring i18n support, dark mode, and section visibility controls.
description.zh: 使用 Astro 和 Tailwind CSS 构建的简约个人网站，支持国际化、暗色模式和区块可见性控制。

description.en: A Python toolkit for machine learning experiments, including data preprocessing, model training, and evaluation utilities.
description.zh: 用于机器学习实验的 Python 工具包，包含数据预处理、模型训练和评估工具。

description.en: A RESTful API for task management with user authentication, built with Go and PostgreSQL, deployed on Docker.
description.zh: 基于 Go 和 PostgreSQL 的任务管理 RESTful API，支持用户认证，Docker 部署。

description.en: A full-stack blog platform with markdown editor, tag system, and comment functionality.
description.zh: 全栈博客平台，支持 Markdown 编辑器、标签系统和评论功能。
